question:
Identify the idiom/phrase that can best substitute the underlined segment.

They discussed __everything__ in the meeting and finalised the next step.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the whole nine yards**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given phrase "**everything**" refers to all aspects or the entirety of something in the context of the given sentence.
 
• The idiom that matches this description is "**the whole nine yards**" (पूरा; सभी कुछ).
 
 
• **Example**: He gave us **the whole nine yards** on how the system works.
 
 
 
• "**The whole nine yards**" implies covering every detail or aspect of something without leaving anything out.
 
• Hence, the correct idiom is **the whole nine yards**.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The home stretch**: Refers to the final phase or part of a process, activity, or competition (अंतिम चरण).
 
• **Through thick and thin**: Means supporting someone or remaining committed in all circumstances, no matter how difficult (कठिनाई और सुख में).
 
• **The eleventh hour**: Refers to the last moment or almost too late (अंतिम क्षण).
